shadowSentences: I enjoy reading books in my free time.
Cooking new recipes can be quite fun.
Traveling to new places makes me happy.
I often listen to music while studying.
Walking in the park helps me relax.
Spending time with friends is very important.
Learning a new language takes dedication and patience.
Exercise is essential for maintaining good health.
Planning my week ahead helps me stay organized.

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about exercise habits.
questions: Q1: What types of exercise do you enjoy doing?
Q2: Have you faced any challenges in sticking to an exercise routine?
Q3: How important do you think exercise is for overall well-being?
Q4: What advice would you give someone trying to start exercising regularly?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about volunteering.
questions: Q1: Can you share a memorable experience from your volunteering work?
Q2: What challenges did you encounter while volunteering?
Q3: Why do you think volunteering is valuable for the community?
Q4: What recommendations would you give to first-time volunteers?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about environmental conservation.
questions: Q1: What actions do you take to help protect the environment?
Q2: Have you faced any obstacles in your efforts to be eco-friendly?
Q3: What is your opinion on the importance of environmental conservation?
Q4: What advice would you give to others wanting to contribute to conservation efforts?
